snippet.title: Angie Magica - Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
WISHLIST NOW ON STEAM!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3985430/Angie_Magica/

Unravel the secrets of Lamentia by harnessing the powers of the Wand of the Eternal Smile with skill and wit while you learn delicious recipes in this gourmet adventure. Fulfill the prophecy and reclaim your rightful place as the ultimate magical girl!

- Discord: https://discord.com/invite/HdFY2rm94F
- Bluesky: https://bsky.app/profile/mangoprotocol.bsky.social
- X (Twitter): https://twitter.com/MangoProtocol
- Instagram: https://instagram.com/mango_protocol/
- Web: https://mangoprotocol.com

Game by Mango Protocol.
Animated scenes by Ciervo Alto.
Audio by Red Forge.
